title: The loop: one token at a time
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers from brain3d/trace.json, films/qkv_data.json, experiments/logs.

blocks.text: We joins the end of the strip. And the whole machine runs again, all 24 blocks, just to choose the next token.
blocks.say: We joins the end of the strip. And the whole machine runs again, all twenty-four blocks, just to choose the next token.

blocks.text: Currently: 48 percent. Have: 80 percent. Then a space. Then, the number.
blocks.say: Currently: forty-eight percent. Have: eighty percent. Then a space. Then, the number.

blocks.text: The first digit is one, at 34 percent. Look at the logit lens: block 21 says four, block 23 says five, and only the last block settles on one. Then zero, 32 percent. And zero, 54.
blocks.say: The first digit is one, at thirty-four percent. Look at the logit lens: block twenty-one says four, block twenty-three says five, and only the last block settles on one. Then zero, thirty-two percent. And zero, fifty-four.

blocks.text: We currently have 100 city e-bike battery packs available in our Manchester stores. Twenty tokens, and every one of them a bet.
blocks.say: We currently have one hundred city e-bike battery packs available in our Manchester stores. Twenty tokens, and every one of them a bet.

blocks.text: Run it five more times at temperature 0.7, and the bets land differently. 300. 150. Over 1,000. 50. 15. Five confident answers, five different numbers. The truth, in Ledgerline, is 5,400.
blocks.say: Run it five more times at temperature zero point seven, and the bets land differently. Three hundred. One hundred and fifty. Over one thousand. Fifty. Fifteen. Five confident answers, five different numbers. The truth, in Ledgerline, is five thousand four hundred.
